measuredBy: DN-17 (#518), research/prototypes/raw_denoise (run_models.py, run_rawrefinery.py, score.py, real_pairs.py, dn17_report.py)
machine: Mac Studio, M1 Ultra, 128 GB; load averages of 36 to 75 from other sessions throughout, so no time here is a performance figure
cases: Synthetic cases are research/benchmarks/denoise.json's synthetic-<scene>-<cfa>-<level> (and <level> clean for noise-free mosaics); RawNIND cases are rawnind-<scene>-iso<N>, scored on the 768 px window that case's crops give

scores.cpsnr: colour PSNR (dB) in a square-root encoding, 16 px borders left out; RawNIND: against the clean frame through Redlamp's demosaic
scores.cpsnr_binned: RawNIND: colour PSNR binned to full colour (2 x 2 Bayer, 3 x 3 X-Trans) against the clean frame binned the same way
scores.texture: share of the truth's 3 x 3 high-pass luma detail kept (1 = all)
scores.edge_mtf50: slanted-edge MTF50, cycles per pixel (the truth's is 0.347)
scores.star_mtf50: Siemens star: where its modulation falls to half
scores.false_colour: mean chroma error where the truth is neutral (zone plate 0.25 to 0.5 cycles per pixel; the star)
scores.flat_luma_noise: luma noise in the text scene's grey patch
scores.shadow_bias: the dark patch's colour cast against the truth
scores.text_cpsnr: colour PSNR over the text panel alone
scores.text_texture: share of the text panel's fine detail kept
scores.text_spurious: fine detail in the result that the truth doesn't have (residual noise, artefacts, anything invented), relative to the truth's

methods.rl-c25: Redlamp main 30810115e, process 20, Detail panel Color 25 (the default), noise model given
methods.rl-l50: Redlamp main 30810115e, process 20, Luminance 50 and Color 25
methods.clean-none: Redlamp's demosaic of the noise-free mosaic (Menon with the dual blend; Markesteijn on X-Trans)
methods.model-autoshade: AutoShade raw denoiser v2 (autoshade-raw-denoise-v2.pth, sha256 ffafa40a53f52092149db2fcf03636117ad6855e1068142d4f6b03b634e9f9c4) as its sidecar runs it (commit 8f25a8a), told the noise model; then Redlamp's demosaic, no noise reduction
methods.model-autoshade-nofield: the same without AutoShade's noise field
methods.model-buades: Sanchez-Beeckman & Buades 2026, rawnoise_25_15_9nbr.ckpt (release v1.0.0, sha256 b31bc8e21022389b0b209a9d1e6649485ed4dacc552b7ea04612df5f7515fcf2), told the noise model; then Redlamp's demosaic
methods.model-pmrid: PMRID torch_pretrained.ckp (MegEngine/PMRID), k-sigma from the noise model; then Redlamp's demosaic
methods.model-rr-jdd: RawForge DemoRestormerDiT_to_demo_cont_cont_768_RawNIND.pt (release JDD_v1.0.0, signature verified), 768 px tiles, float32
methods.model-rr-xtrans-restormer: RawForge restormer.pt (release xtrans_v1.0.0) after LibRaw's Markesteijn
methods.model-starfish: Starfish bayer.pt or xtrans.pt (monkeypangit/starfish b43b610), told the noise model
methods.rr-libraw-3pass: LibRaw's Markesteijn, no noise reduction (X-Trans reference)
